content: Reverse proxy in front of gunicorn is optional when Cloudflare Tunnel already terminates TLS and provides WAF/DDoS/CDN. Many self-hosters point cloudflared directly at the app server (gunicorn bound to 127.0.0.1 or a unix socket) and drop nginx entirely for single-app, low-traffic setups; nginx remains useful when you need to front multiple local services, local caching, or complex routing.
